name: RackNerd
tagline: Budget KVM VPS hosting with frequent flash-sale pricing
description: RackNerd is a budget VPS host built around rotating flash-sale pricing rather than fixed plan tiers, offering KVM VPS, dedicated servers and colocation across roughly 20 data center locations worldwide.
about: RackNerd's headline pricing isn't a fixed rate card — it runs frequent time-limited VPS specials (often countdown-timer deals on its own specials page) where the same RAM/CPU/storage tier can be priced differently from one promo to the next. As of this writing, its published KVM VPS tiers on annual billing start around $21.99/year for 1GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 20GB SSD and 3TB bandwidth, scaling up to roughly $119.99/year for 8GB RAM, 7 vCPUs, 150GB SSD and 20TB bandwidth — but treat any specific number as a snapshot, not a guaranteed rate, since deal pricing rotates.

Every plan ships with SolusVM as the VPS management interface, not cPanel — RackNerd does not bundle a web-hosting control panel by default. cPanel (or similar panels) shows up occasionally as a paid add-on or bundled option on specific deals rather than a standard inclusion, so anyone expecting a one-click cPanel experience out of the box should budget for that separately or plan to manage the server via SSH/SolusVM instead.

faqs.q: Does RackNerd include cPanel with its VPS plans?
faqs.a: Not by default. RackNerd's standard VPS plans use SolusVM for management, not cPanel. cPanel is sometimes available as a paid add-on or bundled into specific promotional deals, but it's not a built-in feature of the base plans — check the exact deal's terms before assuming it's included.

faqs.q: Is RackNerd's advertised VPS price fixed?
faqs.a: No. RackNerd relies heavily on rotating, time-limited flash-sale pricing (often shown with a countdown timer on its specials page), so the price for a given RAM/CPU/storage tier can change from one promotion to the next. Always check the live specials page for the current rate rather than relying on a number seen elsewhere.

faqs.q: Where are RackNerd's data centers located?
faqs.a: RackNerd operates VPS and dedicated server locations across roughly 20 cities, including Los Angeles, Dallas, New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Ashburn, Amsterdam, London, Frankfurt, Dublin and Singapore, letting customers pick a region closer to their audience.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get RackNerd's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some RackNerd deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with RackNerd?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on RackNerd's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.
